instruction: Treat `review.sch` in EAGLE 7.7.0, run EAGLE's Electrical Rule Check, and save a plain-text transcription of the ERC Errors window as `/home/user/Desktop/answer.erc` as the starting point. Start EAGLE from `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` and open `review.sch` there. EAGLE 7.7.0 does not provide a native `.erc` export action, so copy the displayed ERC result into the text file. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/answer.erc` must exist and be non-empty. 2. It must be readable as plain text. 3. It must identify EAGLE 7.7.0, `review.sch`, and the ERC Errors result. 4. It must record the complete result shown for this starter schematic: 2 errors and 4 warnings. 5. It must not add issues that EAGLE does not report.

command: import pyautogui; import time; time.sleep(8); w, h = pyautogui.size(); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 100, h/2 + 25); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 + 213, h/2 + 146); time.sleep(2); pyautogui.click(w/2 - 80, h/2 + 68); time.sleep(5)
